units.text: {el} brings Body for a whole year, the strength your chart runs short of. You stand your ground more easily, and peers start to treat you as an equal.
{el} brings Body for a whole year, the force your chart already runs over with. Competition with peers runs hot, and you come through it by sharing the load with a team that pushes back.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, the energy you need most. Help and good teachers find their way to you, and you learn more in these months than in several years before.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, the support your chart still welcomes. Study comes easily and people offer shelter, and you think things through before you act.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, the thinking your chart already has too much of. Plans stay on paper longer than they should, and you get moving again through plain work and a firm deadline.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, the energy you need most. Talent you kept quiet finds an audience, and you say and make more than in any year before.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, the outlet your chart holds and still enjoys. What you make and say lands well, and you take real pleasure in your own talent.

{el} brings Expression for a whole year, the voice and appetite your chart already overflows with. Words come out sharper than you mean, and you keep your footing through a fixed routine and someone who holds you to your word.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, the energy you need most. Offers and money come within reach, and you get your hands on more than you have in years.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, the reach your chart holds and still wants. Effort pays back promptly and practical plans move, and you finish the year with more to show for your work.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, the chase your chart cannot keep up with. There is more to manage than hours to manage it, and you get through on your own steady strength and a short list.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, the structure your chart still welcomes. A role with clear rules settles around you, and you earn a name as the one others count on.

{el} brings Order for a whole year, the pressure and duty your chart already carries too much of. Deadlines and people above you crowd in, and you hold steady through study, a mentor's help and a quiet hour of your own.
You draw closer to an older relative this year, and an old family tie turns into a real friendship.
You draw the people after you closer this year, and a younger relative or someone you train comes to count on you.
Something shifts in the family you came from this year, a parent changes address or an older relative changes course, and you adjust quickly.
An older relative watches you more closely this year, and you meet old family expectations with more patience than before.
Someone you train or a younger relative tests your standards this year, and you keep them firm without raising your voice.
A quiet coolness settles between you and a parent or grandparent this year, and you warm it again with a visit or a call.
Someone you have trained or helped along pulls back without a word this year, and you notice the distance before it hardens.
Your older relatives rally around one family plan this year, and you find yourself at the centre of it.
Work brings back an old project this year, and you close a question you thought was done.
Home returns to an old question this year, a habit or a plan you and your partner set aside, and you settle it properly.
An old plan you made for the people after you comes round again this year, and you see it more clearly the second time.
